title: Min and Max in One Pass

docs.title: Functions — Functions with Multiple Return Values

hints: A function can return a tuple with labels — and an optional tuple for the empty case.
Start from the first element (guard it exists), then update min and max in one loop over the rest.
`guard var lo = nums.first else { return nil }; var hi = lo; for n in nums.dropFirst() { lo = Swift.min(lo, n); hi = Swift.max(hi, n) }; return (lo, hi)`.
